newsitem.title: USA: Vitronics to vigorously defend suit.
newsitem.headline: Vitronics to vigorously defend suit.

text.p: Vitronics Corp said Thursday it would "vigorously" defend itself against a lawsuit filed by Conceptronic Inc over supposed malicious prosecution in a patent infringement case.
"Vitronics believes the recent claims by Conceptronic are totally without merit and intends to vigorously defend this lawsuit," it said.
On December 23, Conceptronic, the defendant in the patent infringement case, filed a lawsuit against the company, citing malicious prosecution and abuse of the legal process.
It said Vitronics knew or should have known its case was without merit when it accused Conceptronic of infringement in New Hampshire State Court in 1991.
Conceptronic, which makes computer-controlled capital equipment, said it was suing for no less than $1.3 million, with additional amounts to be determined.
Vitronics supplies thermal processing and associated equipment.
